title.en: Electric 15 or the rural diesel for a self-built house?
title.zh: 自建房选电动15还是农村柴油泵？

description.en: Grid and 15–20 m vertical: Electric 15 at 8–10 m³/h and 60–80 m horizontal. No grid: the 17 kW rural diesel at 5–8 m³/h and 30–50 m horizontal.
description.zh: 有电网且垂直 15–20 m：电动15，8–10 m³/h，水平 60–80 m。无电网：17 kW 农村柴油泵，5–8 m³/h，水平 30–50 m。

h1.en: Electric 15 or the rural diesel for a self-built house?
h1.zh: 自建房选电动15还是农村柴油泵？

directAnswer.en: If the house has a supply for 15 kW, open Electric 15: 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, 450 kg. If it does not, open the rural diesel: 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, 800 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural self-built houses on both. The distances are not the same.
directAnswer.zh: 住宅能供给 15 kW 时，打开电动15：8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、450 kg。不能时，打开农村柴油泵：17 kW、5–8 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、骨料 1–3 cm、800 kg。邢台河北品锦机械在两台上都印了农村自建房。距离并不相同。

heading.en: Shared stone is not shared reach
heading.zh: 石子相同不等于距离相同

body.en: Both allow 1–3 cm. Electric 15 does not print pressure. The diesel prints 15 MPa and a 0.2 m³ hopper. Electric 15 prints pipe 100–125 mm and does not print a hopper. A buyer who only matches “self-built” and “1–3 cm” has not chosen a pump yet.
body.zh: 两台都允许 1–3 cm。电动15没有印压力。柴油泵印了 15 MPa 和 0.2 m³ 料斗。电动15印了管径 100–125 mm，没有印料斗。只对照“自建房”和“1–3 cm”的采购方，还没有选定泵。

heading.en: The published two-to-three-floor note stays electric
heading.zh: 已发布的两三层说明留在电动这一侧

body.en: That note sits beside Electric 15’s 15–20 m vertical cell. It does not move onto the diesel, and this page still refuses to convert floors into metres. Without a grid, ignore the floor phrase and measure the diesel window instead.
body.zh: 那篇说明靠着电动15的垂直 15–20 m。它不会挪到柴油泵上，本页仍然拒绝把楼层换成米。没有电网时，放下楼层那句话，改为量柴油窗口。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Answer one question first: can the site feed 15 kW? Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请先回答一个问题：现场能否供给 15 kW？ 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: Electric 15 at 450 kg. The rural diesel is 800 kg.
answer.zh: 电动15是 450 kg。农村柴油泵是 800 kg。

answer.en: Electric 15, at 60–80 m, and only with grid power.
answer.zh: 电动15，60–80 m，而且只有在有电网时。

question.zh: 电动20是自建房的升级吗？

answer.en: Electric 20 is the building and commercial row at 120 m / 40 m and 1–2 cm stone. It is not named as the rural model.
answer.zh: 电动20是 120 m / 40 m、石子 1–2 cm 的建筑与商业行。它没有被命名为农村型号。
